summary.text: Timothy Lamb is the Democratic-NPL nominee for Attorney General. A Grand Forks attorney and University of North Dakota law graduate, he is the 2022 nominee for the same office and proposes a criminal justice review panel and a citizen review board for fraud.

paragraphs.text: Lamb, who goes by Tim, was born in Grand Forks.

According to a biography he gave the Grand Forks Herald, he holds a journalism degree from the University of North Dakota, a business master's degree from Central Michigan University and a law degree from the UND School of Law, and he served in the U.S. Army for more than 20 years.
The Herald also reports he spent 15 years on the Grand Forks School Board.
Lamb owns the Lamb Law Office in Grand Forks.
He was the Democratic-NPL nominee for attorney general in 2022, losing to Drew Wrigley with about 31% of the vote, and ran for state auditor in 2024.
He accepted the party's nomination for attorney general again in 2026.
